title: Can 5G Spread Viruses? No. Here's Why
description:
In 2020, online posts linked 5G to COVID-19 and some towers were damaged. The WHO said viruses can't travel on radio waves, COVID spread where there was no 5G, and the UN's ITU called the link a hoax.

Sources:
• UN News (Apr 2020): https://news.un.org/en/story/2020/04/1062362
• UN Namibia: WHO myth busters: https://namibia.un.org/en/41807-covid-19-myth-busters-knowthefacts
• UK Government: 5G and coronavirus: https://www.gov.uk/guidance/5g-and-coronavirus-covid-19
• Boston University (2021): https://www.bu.edu/hic/2021/01/04/5g-doesnt-cause-covid-19-but-the-rumor-it-does-spread-like-a-virus/
